fact: The party returns to Blingdenstone much sooner than the leaders expected.
source_quote: The party returns much sooner than Blingdenstone’s leaders expected
subject: party return

fact: Nearby gnomes pretend to work while listening to the meeting.
source_quote: Nearby gnomes pretend to concentrate on their work while straining to overhear the important meeting.
subject: gnome eavesdropping

fact: Chief Dorbo asks the party if the ooze problem has been dealt with.
source_quote: Chief Dorbo opens with a blunt question: “Has my ooze problem been dealt with?”
subject: Chief Dorbo

fact: The party informs Dorbo they have a solution but need Blingdenstone's help.
source_quote: The party answers that they have discovered a means of dealing with the oozes but need Blingdenstone’s help.
subject: party response to Dorbo

fact: The party reveals the existence of the Pudding King and his controlled ooze army.
source_quote: They reveal the Pudding King, his slime-covered throne room, and the hundreds of oozes gathered under his control.
subject: Pudding King reveal

fact: Chief Dorbo reacts to the reveal with horror.
source_quote: Dorbo reacts, “This is awful. This is terrible. This is cataclysmical. This is a catastrophe.”
subject: Chief Dorbo

fact: Gyrgum proposes a plan where his speech distracts the oozes while the party kills their king.
source_quote: Gyrgum explains, “The plan is I make a motivational speech to your army, and they distract the oozes while we kill their king.”
subject: Gyrgum

fact: Gyrgum interprets the room's silence as approval.
source_quote: the room answers with stunned silence, prompting Gyrgum to ask, “It’s that good, isn’t it?”
subject: Gyrgum

fact: Senni interrupts Dorbo and asks the party to detail their route to the Pudding King.
source_quote: Senni tells Dorbo, “I think you’ve spoken enough,” before asking the party to explain exactly how they will reach the Pudding King.
subject: Senni

fact: Zalthir offers a demonstration of his mobility to prove the mission's viability.
source_quote: To prove that the mission is not simply a suicide attack, Zalthir offers a demonstration of his mobility.
subject: Zalthir

fact: The gnomes extinguish the chamber's lights to watch the demonstration.
source_quote: they now eagerly extinguish the chamber’s lights.
subject: lights extinguished

fact: Zalthir Shadow Steps around the room using sixty-foot jumps and acrobatics.
source_quote: In the dimness, Zalthir Shadow Steps around the room in sixty-foot jumps, adding flips and airborne punches for effect.
subject: Zalthir demonstration

fact: Senni describes the plan for Zalthir to kill the Pudding King while Blingdenstone's forces occupy the ooze army.
source_quote: Senni summarizes the method: Zalthir will sneak into the throne room, seize the Pudding King, and kill or extract him while Blingdenstone’s forces occupy the ooze army.
subject: Senni summarizes plan

fact: Chief Dorbo declares the party's plan to be the dumbest he has ever heard.
source_quote: Dorbo declares, “It is the dumbest plan I’ve heard ever.”
subject: Chief Dorbo

fact: Senni challenges Dorbo to propose a better plan.
source_quote: Senni asks, “Do you have a better one?” Dorbo answers only with silence.
subject: Senni

fact: Jimjar unexpectedly announces he wants to make a bet.
source_quote: Jimjar unexpectedly tells Dorbo, “I want to make a bet, Chief.”
subject: Jimjar

fact: Jimjar bets that the party and Blingdenstone will live happily ever after.
source_quote: Jimjar wagers, “I’ll make you a bet that by the time this is all done, we’re all going to be living happily ever after.”
subject: Jimjar's bet

fact: Jimjar is usually motivated by self-serving bets.
source_quote: Because Jimjar ordinarily uses bets for his own advantage
subject: Jimjar

fact: Chief Dorbo argues Blingdenstone lacks the preparation to fight oozes.
source_quote: Dorbo admits that the party may have a point but argues that Blingdenstone cannot simply march out and fight oozes; its forces lack suitable preparation, allies, and equipment.
subject: Chief Dorbo

fact: Senni calls for a full clan meeting with the Stoneheart Enclave and Miners’ Guild.
source_quote: Senni calls for a full clan meeting involving the Stoneheart Enclave and the Miners’ Guild.
subject: Senni

fact: Chief Dorbo refuses to invite the Goldwhisker clan.
source_quote: Dorbo tries to limit the gathering to those groups, declaring that he will not invite “those Goldwhisker” because “They’re not even gnomes.”
subject: Goldwhisker

fact: Senni identifies the Goldwhiskers as lycanthropes who transform into rats.
source_quote: Senni replies that they are lycanthropes who merely turn into rats and urges Dorbo to let bygones be bygones for the common good.
subject: Goldwhisker

fact: The Goldwhiskers are resistant to non-silver weapons.
source_quote: Their resistance to non-silver weapons makes the Goldwhiskers a potentially important asset in a war against oozes.
subject: Goldwhisker

fact: Chief Dorbo conditions Goldwhisker participation on acknowledging his authority.
source_quote: Dorbo says he might accept their participation if they acknowledge that he is in charge.
subject: Chief Dorbo

fact: Daz rejects the leadership structure and asserts the party's command.
source_quote: Daz rejects the premise and announces that the party is taking command of the operation.
subject: Daz

fact: Daz states the party will lead the operation.
source_quote: Daz declares, “We figured it out, and we’re going to be in charge of it.”
subject: Daz

fact: Daz criticizes the current leaders for causing the situation.
source_quote: He continues, “We’re not going to have some stupid bickering amongst the people that think they’re in power trying to—that got us into this situation.”
subject: Daz

fact: Daz proposes a bargain for the party to guide the party out of the Underdark in exchange for solving the ooze problem.
source_quote: Daz lays out the bargain: “You’re going to get us out of the Underdark, and we’re going to solve this problem for you, and we’re going to do it our way. So you’re on board.”
subject: Daz

fact: The chamber falls silent after Daz's declaration of command.
source_quote: The chamber falls silent at the abrupt “management coup.”
subject: chamber silence

fact: Senni accepts the new command structure and assigns the party to recruit Clan Goldwhisker.
source_quote: Senni accepts the new command structure and tells the adventurers, “You bring the Goldwhisker clans, and I think we could make that happen.”
subject: Senni

fact: The party sets out to recruit Clan Goldwhisker.
source_quote: The party agrees and sets out with a new immediate objective: recruit Clan Goldwhisker into the war on ooze.
subject: party departure
